name: Bulbasaur
passive_desc: +1.5 regen and +25% healing. Your Grass attacks heal you a little (0.4% of HP per hit, up to 5 times per second).

name: Charmander
passive_desc: Below 40% HP, +40% damage. +10% Fire damage.

name: Squirtle
passive_desc: +15 armor and +20 shield. Below 40% HP, +40% damage.

name: Caterpie
passive_desc: +15% experience and +20 shield. Evolves soon (Metapod at Lv. 8, Butterfree at Lv. 36). As Metapod, the cocoon gives you +30 armor.

name: Weedle
passive_desc: +10% attack speed. Your crits poison and poisoned enemies take +20% damage. Evolves soon (Kakuna at Lv. 8, Beedrill at Lv. 36); as Kakuna, +30 armor.

name: Pidgey
passive_desc: +12% speed, +20% projectile speed and +1 jump. Like any good Flying type, you glide by holding Jump.

name: Rattata
passive_desc: +25% physical damage and +10% attack speed, in exchange for -8% HP.

name: Spearow
passive_desc: +8% crit and +50% crit damage.

name: Ekans
passive_desc: +1 regen (Shed Skin). Every 4 s your gaze paralyzes the enemies in front of you (7 m).

name: Pikachu
passive_desc: Anyone who touches you is paralyzed. Every 4 s you fire a discharge at an enemy.

name: Sandshrew
passive_desc: +10 armor and +6% crit. In a sandstorm, +30% speed.

name: Nidoran♀
passive_desc: +15% HP and +10 armor. Anyone who touches you is poisoned, and poisoned enemies spread it when they die.

name: Nidoran♂
passive_desc: +10% damage and +25% against elites, Alphas and bosses.

name: Clefairy
passive_desc: +20 luck and +1 regen. Your Ultimate charges 30% faster and when you cast it you recover 15% HP.

name: Vulpix
passive_desc: +20% Fire damage and +15% status damage.

name: Jigglypuff
passive_desc: Anyone who touches you is charmed. +5% evasion.

name: Zubat
passive_desc: +8% lifesteal and +20% healing.
challenge: Recover 4,000 HP in a single run.

name: Oddish
passive_desc: +10% speed and +1 regen. In sun, +30% speed and +20% damage. Every 6 s you release a pollen cloud (4.5 m) that poisons.

name: Paras
passive_desc: +20% status chance. Anyone who touches you falls asleep, gets paralyzed or gets poisoned. As Parasect, the mushroom is in control: +20% damage against enemies with any status.

name: Venonat
passive_desc: +8% crit and +15% status chance. Confused enemies take +25% damage. As Venomoth, +12% attack speed.

name: Diglett
passive_desc: +10 armor. Every 2 s the ground shakes around you (4.5 m): it damages and traps enemies in the sand (root). As Dugtrio, 6 m.

name: Meowth
passive_desc: +40% PokéDollars and +2 pickup. Every 100 ₽ you earn in a run gives you +1% crit (up to +15%). As Persian, +10% speed.

name: Psyduck
passive_desc: +10% HP. The hits you take and the passage of time charge your headache; when full, it bursts into a psychic wave (7 m) that damages and confuses. As Golduck, the wave is 10 m and heals you for 8%.

name: Mankey
passive_desc: +8 armor. Every hit you take enrages you: +6% damage per charge (up to 6; as Primeape, up to 8). The rage fades after 5 s without taking damage.

name: Growlithe
passive_desc: +10% speed. Every 3 s, nearby enemies are intimidated (they deal -40% damage).

name: Poliwag
passive_desc: +10% HP and +20% projectile speed. In rain, +30% speed and +20% damage. As Poliwrath, +15% physical damage.

name: Abra
passive_desc: Immune to damage from the ground (lava, fire pools, cracks, spore clouds). -30% damage from projectiles and area attacks.

name: Machop
passive_desc: +25% physical damage.

name: Bellsprout
passive_desc: +10% HP. Your Strikes and Spins deal +15% damage and can root (20%). KOs of rooted enemies heal you for 2% of HP.

name: Tentacool
passive_desc: +10 armor. Every 2 s your tentacles lash the 2 closest enemies within 7 m (they poison); Tentacruel lashes 4.
challenge: Poison 2,500 Pokémon in a single run.

name: Geodude
passive_desc: You survive a lethal hit with 1 HP once per run. +10 armor.

name: Ponyta
passive_desc: +15% speed. As you move you leave fire footprints that burn enemies. As Rapidash, +10% speed and bigger footprints.

name: Slowpoke
passive_desc: +25% HP, +1.5 regen and -10% speed. Every 6 s you yawn: enemies within 6 m may fall asleep. As Slowbro, the Shellder on its tail gives you +20 armor.

name: Magnemite
passive_desc: +4 pickup range. Every 4 s a magnetic pulse pulls in enemies within 9 m and may paralyze them. As Magneton, the pulse also damages them.
challenge: Paralyze 1,500 Pokémon in a single run.

name: Farfetch’d
passive_desc: +10% crit. You always carry a leek: 4% of your hits are an ×8 "Bonk!" (stacks with the Leek item).
challenge: Land 50,000 critical hits in a single run.

name: Doduo
passive_desc: +10% speed. Each attack has a 25% chance to repeat instantly with the other head. As Dodrio, 35%.

name: Seel
passive_desc: +15% HP and +10 armor. Every 4 s ice shards burst around you (5 m) and gradually freeze enemies. As Dewgong, 6.5 m.

name: Grimer
passive_desc: -15% damage taken. When hit, you leave a toxic puddle for 4 s that poisons and traps anyone who steps in it. As Muk, the puddles are bigger.

name: Shellder
passive_desc: +20 armor and +1 projectile. As Cloyster, +1 projectile and +10 more armor.
challenge: Dodge 25 attacks in a single run.

name: Gastly
passive_desc: You plow through the horde: -20% damage taken and +10% evasion.
challenge: Trigger 600 elemental reactions in a single run.

name: Onix
passive_desc: +25 armor and +15% HP, in exchange for -8% speed. Your Charges deal +30% damage. Every 6 s rocks fall on the 3 closest enemies.

name: Drowzee
passive_desc: +10% status chance. Every 7 s your pendulum puts the 3 closest enemies to sleep (Hypno, 5). Sleeping enemies within 6 m heal you for 0.5% of HP per second each (up to 5).
challenge: Put 1,500 Pokémon to sleep in a single run.

name: Krabby
passive_desc: +6 armor. Your Strikes deal +20% damage. Every 5th hit of a Strike is a pincer that deals double damage and stuns (Kingler, every 4th).
challenge: Get 15,000 KOs in a single run.

name: Voltorb
passive_desc: +15% speed. Enemies you defeat have a 12% chance to explode (3 m, Electric damage that paralyzes); with Electrode, 20%.

name: Exeggcute
passive_desc: +20% healing. Every 15 s a berry appears beside you. As Exeggutor, +10% area.

name: Cubone
passive_desc: +10 armor. Your bone attacks deal +20% damage. Below 40% HP, +35% damage.
challenge: Defeat 4 guardians of the Rocky Desert.

name: Hitmonlee
passive_desc: +20% area and +1 jump. Your kicks (attacks with "kick") deal +20% damage.
challenge: Have 20 members in your League. / Defeat 30 Alpha Pokémon.

name: Hitmonchan
passive_desc: +5% physical damage. Your punches (attacks with "punch") deal +20% damage. Every 3 s you throw an automatic punch at the closest enemy within 4 m.
challenge: Have 20 members in your League. / Defeat 25 guardians.

name: Lickitung
passive_desc: +4 pickup range and +20% HP. Every 4 s your tongue grabs the closest enemy within 8 m, pulls it toward you and paralyzes it.
challenge: Have 15 members in your League. / Recover 7,000 HP in a single run.

name: Koffing
passive_desc: You levitate: hold Jump to glide and you can climb walls. A 4 m gas cloud surrounds you and poisons every second. As Weezing, 5.5 m.

name: Rhyhorn
passive_desc: +15 armor. After 1.5 s of running without stopping, you charge: enemies you touch take damage and are sent flying.
challenge: Have 20 members in your League. / Smash 100 rocks with Rock Smash.

name: Chansey
passive_desc: +40% HP and +40% healing. Every 10 s you lay an egg beside you that heals you for 10% when picked up.
challenge: Have 25 members in your League. / Recover 60,000 HP in total.

name: Tangela
passive_desc: +2 regen. Every 5 s your vines trap (root) and damage the 4 closest enemies within 7 m.
challenge: Have 20 members in your League. / Reach level 35 in a run.

name: Kangaskhan
passive_desc: Your baby fights alongside you: every hit of your attacks is repeated at 25% of its damage.
challenge: Have 25 members in your League. / Complete 35 runs (win or lose).

name: Horsea
passive_desc: +10% crit and +25% crit damage. Your crits cover the enemy in ink and blind it: it deals -40% damage and common enemies stop attacking.

name: Goldeen
passive_desc: +10% evasion. Every dodge wraps you in water: a shield worth 6% of your HP. As Seaking, +5% evasion.

name: Staryu
passive_desc: +20% projectile speed. Every 8 s your core heals you for 5%. As Starmie, +10% special damage.

name: Mr. Mime
passive_desc: Every 6 s you raise an invisible barrier: a shield worth 10% of your HP and a wall that pushes back enemies within 4 m.

name: Scyther
passive_desc: +15% attack speed and +10% damage.

name: Jynx
passive_desc: Anyone who touches you is charmed. Your hits on charmed enemies gradually freeze them.
challenge: Have 25 members in your League. / Freeze 1,500 Pokémon in a single run.

name: Electabuzz
passive_desc: Every time you paralyze an enemy you gain +2% damage for 4 s (up to 15 stacks).
challenge: Have 25 members in your League. / Paralyze 3,000 Pokémon in a single run.

name: Magmar
passive_desc: Anyone who touches you is burned. Burned enemies you defeat burst into flames (3 m) and burn those around them.
challenge: Have 25 members in your League. / Burn 6,000 Pokémon in a single run.

name: Pinsir
passive_desc: +15% damage. You ignore enemy shields (like Fighting attacks) and deal +20% to bosses and mini-bosses. Storm Throw is always a crit.
challenge: Have 20 members in your League. / Defeat 4 Alpha Pokémon in a single run.

name: Tauros
passive_desc: +15% speed. While running, every 0.5 s you ram the enemies in front of you (2.5 m): damage and a good shove.
challenge: Have 20 members in your League. / Get 300,000 KOs in total.

name: Magikarp
passive_desc: +60% experience. With it, it reaches a fearsome evolution before anyone else (Lv. 40).

name: Lapras
passive_desc: You take -15% damage. +0.5 regen.
challenge: Have 30 members in your League. / Evolve 20 times during your runs.

name: Ditto
passive_desc: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 30 s you copy the types of the nearest enemy: your type bonus and your weaknesses change.
challenge: Have 25 members in your League. / Capture 25 Support Alphas.

name: Eevee
passive_desc: +25% damage with moves of your own type (the type bonus goes from ×1.25 to ×1.56).
challenge: Have 15 members in your League. / Play with 10 different Pokémon.

name: Porygon
passive_desc: +12% special damage and projectile speed. Every 10 s you download data: your next 5 hits are crits.
challenge: Have 30 members in your League. / Trigger 1,200 elemental reactions in a single run.

name: Omanyte
passive_desc: +20 armor. Your Rock and Water attacks deal +15% damage. Every 5 s, a ring of rocks bursts from your shell (5 m; Omastar 6.5 m).
challenge: Have 25 members in your League. / Get 50,000 KOs in the Rocky Desert.

name: Kabuto
passive_desc: +15 armor. Each hit you take is reduced by 3 + 0.3 per level. As Kabutops, your Strikes and Boomerangs deal +20% damage.
challenge: Have 25 members in your League. / Defeat 8 guardians of the Rocky Desert.

name: Aerodactyl
passive_desc: +15% speed and +1 jump; you glide by holding Jump. While airborne, your attacks deal +25% damage.
challenge: Have 35 members in your League. / Win the Rocky Desert.

name: Snorlax
passive_desc: +30% healing.
challenge: Have 30 members in your League. / Eat 500 berries or healing items.

name: Articuno
passive_desc: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every second, enemies within 6 m gradually freeze.
challenge: Have 45 members in your League. / Win Viridian Forest on Hard. / Freeze 2,500 Pokémon in a single run.

name: Zapdos
passive_desc: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 5 s three lightning bolts strike nearby enemies and paralyze them.
challenge: Have 50 members in your League. / Win the Rocky Desert. / Defeat 3,000 Pokémon in the rain in a single run.

name: Moltres
passive_desc: Legendary: +10% damage, HP and speed. Every 6 s a 6 m ring of flames burns the enemies.
challenge: Have 55 members in your League. / Defeat Moltres in the Rocky Desert on Hard. / Burn 8,000 Pokémon in a single run.

name: Dratini
passive_desc: At full HP you take -50% damage.
challenge: Have 40 members in your League. / Defeat 3 legendary Pokémon.

name: Mewtwo
passive_desc: +15% damage, area and speed. Every 8 s a psychic barrier gives you a shield worth 15% of your HP. Your crits stun.
challenge: Have 60 members in your League. / Capture Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres. / Win the Rocky Desert on Hard.

name: Mew
passive_desc: +10% damage, speed, area and HP. Can learn moves of any type.
